name: @tsci/seveibar.basic-usbc-devices

scripts.build: bun build.tsx && bun export.tsx && bun make-viewer.ts && bun verify.ts && bun render.ts panel limit button toggle dial position distance
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && bun verify.ts && bun verify.ts panel2 && bun verify-hub.ts
scripts.build:panel2: bun export.tsx panel2 && bun make-viewer.ts panel2 && bun verify.ts panel2 && bun render.ts panel2
scripts.build:hub: bun build.tsx hub && bun export-hub.ts && bun verify-hub.ts && bun render.ts hub
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:panel2 && bun run build:hub

description: Compact USB-C input and homing modules, six-up panels, and a four-port USB 2.0 hub
